overall_assessment: All 28 courses were read in full: no remaining personal data or substantive course-content loss was found, and the previously reported MEDEPI staff name is now removed. All eight reviewed name_like flags are false alarms for historical figures, programme/organisation names or technical terminology; both admin_date flags correctly identify dated seminar schedules. The random controls additionally reveal missed reading-list publication boilerplate and dangling prose after removals, with defects affecting a minority of the packet.

findings.description: Both FSKLI901 offerings retain dated meeting schedules under Undervisningssemester, including explicit 2025 dates. These are administrative scheduling dates, which the rubric requires removing. Both pre-pass admin_date flags are true positives; the meeting rooms are not tied to a person and are not a separate PII leak.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R: .anon_generic() removes spelled-out dates in approval/update contexts or timestamps with clock times, but not ordinary weekday-plus-date schedule lines. .anon_uib() has no meeting-schedule rule. A direct reproduction confirms that the spring schedule line survives unchanged.
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_uib(), remove weekday-plus-date rows within the explicitly introduced meeting schedule in Undervisningssemester. Accept full and abbreviated Norwegian month names, optional spaces after the day dot, and optional years so the neighbouring yearless schedule rows are handled too; stop at the next section heading and preserve teaching descriptions and recurring semester values.

findings.evidence:
Litteraturliste
Juni for haustsemesteret og 1. januar for vårsemesteret.
findings.description: The reading-list publication sentence is only partly removed in three offerings. HTEK101 retains a month-and-semester fragment, while both ENG120 offerings append the orphan phrase for haustsemesteret to the preceding content sentence. These are broken sentences rather than harmless empty administrative labels; the pre-pass artifact check does not detect them.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R: .anon_uib() terminates its reading-list match at a full stop unless the date-dot lookahead accepts what follows. That lookahead only permits digits or spaces/tabs followed by lowercase letters. The capitalised month in 1. Juni reproducibly stops removal after 1.; the ENG120 removed spans similarly show termination at 01.07. before the semester clause.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the ambiguous full-stop scan with explicit numeric and named-month date alternatives, allowing capitalised month names, horizontal Unicode whitespace and optional date-final dots. Consume the optional for haustsemesteret / og ... for vårsemesteret clauses with the boilerplate sentence, while preserving the next substantive sentence. Cover the HTEK101 and ENG120 packet variants.

findings.evidence: Litteraturlista vil vere tilgjengeleg på uib.no 1. juni for haustsemesteret og 1. desember for vårsemesteret.
findings.description: Two random controls retain variants of the reading-list publication-date boilerplate that the UiB handler explicitly targets: vil vere tilgjengeleg på uib.no in AHKR391 and vil normalt vere klar innan in PRPSYK301C. These unflagged sentences describe publication logistics, not reading-list content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R: .anon_uib() requires vil ver[ae] klare? inn[ae]n directly after the reading-list subject. It does not accept normalt between vil and vere, or tilgjengeleg på uib.no instead of klar innan. Both packet sentences reproducibly survive unchanged.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the anchored reading-list publication-sentence grammar to allow optional normalt and the alternative vere tilgjengeleg på uib.no followed by a publication date. Reuse explicit date and semester-clause matching, and retain sentences describing actual required literature or page counts.

findings.evidence: kan søke om utsatt innleveringsfrist til. Søknaden må sendes før fristen for å levere er gått ut.
findings.description: Removing the application email leaves the assessment-policy sentence ending innleveringsfrist til. The policy itself remains, but its contact clause is grammatically broken. This is an unflagged defect in a random control, rather than an empty staff/contact heading.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R: the generic email pattern removes the address and its leading whitespace, leaving the preceding preposition til and the sentence-final full stop. Reproducing the contact sentence yields exactly the fragment shown in the packet.
findings.suggested_fix: Before generic email removal, add a narrowly scoped UiB rewrite for utsatt/utsett innleveringsfrist til followed by an email: retain the extension-policy phrase and final punctuation while removing the preposition with the address. Preserve the following application-deadline sentence.

findings.evidence:
Haust og vår.

Emnet byrjar å gå frå.
findings.description: Removal of the initial offering semester/year leaves the incomplete sentence Emnet byrjar å gå frå. in a random control. The surrounding recurring teaching-semester information is intact, but this leftover administrative sentence no longer conveys a complete statement and is not a standalone empty field label.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R: .anon_generic() removes the season-plus-year token from running prose without removing the now-empty course-start sentence. Applying the current anonymizer to Emnet byrjar å gå frå våren 2024. reproduces the packet output.
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_uib(), remove the complete administrative sentence matching Emnet byrjar å gå frå plus a semester and year before generic season removal. Preserve the adjacent Haust og vår. teaching-semester statement, and cover the exact packet sentence in regression checks.
